comparison.objective: Unmold a tart by supporting it on a stand and lowering a loose pan ring; candidate finishes threaded inserts by tang fracture and recovery.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual support and gentle ring removal differ from coaxial mandrel stabilization, controlled hammer impact, and millimetre-scale metal-fragment retrieval.
comparison.success_condition: Tart released intact from its ring versus four fractured and tray-contained tangs with all inserts and shell undamaged. Record has no specs or detailed rubric.
comparison.reason: Shared bimanual handling does not make food unmolding equivalent to controlled impact fracture.
